title: Ai Mode
description: Retrieve Google AI Mode Markdown and metadata. Use standardize.clean and extract.ai afterwards for cleanup and structuring.

recipe_writer.reason: Automatically documented from schema; execution eligibility requires review.

configuration_schema.description: Retrieve Google AI Mode Markdown and metadata. Use standardize.clean and extract.ai afterwards for cleanup and structuring.

queries.description: Column containing one query string per row. Explode query lists before searching.

id.description: Input row ID column, retained in metadata.input_row_id.

output.description:
Outputs are ordered [ai_mode_results, ai_mode_metadata]. The first is
the untouched Markdown body; the optional second is the YAML frontmatter
as a JSON-compatible dictionary, with query, query_index, input_row_id,
search_id, status and error. Search requests output=md. It does not parse
headings, select references, clean the body or extract prices. Blank
queries have status Skipped. Missing/malformed metadata, provider errors
and empty successful answers are explicit errors; non-success rows must
not be passed to extraction. query_config and the previous three-output
compact/complete/Markdown contract are no longer supported.

include_raw_response.description: Retain the untouched Markdown response including frontmatter under metadata.raw_response for trial capture and replay.

country.description: Optional country code. Alias: gl. Null or empty means omit.

gl.description: Optional country code; omitted unless supplied.

language.description: Optional language code. Alias: hl. Null or empty means omit.

hl.description: Optional language code; omitted unless supplied.

location.description: Optional city or geographic location; omitted unless supplied.
